summary: Implemented upper.convert CSV catalog importer (stdlib csv/io/decimal only, no global mutable state): strips optional BOM; empty input -> empty lists; stripped header must equal sku,name,price else single {line:1,code:header}; csv.reader over StringIO(newline='') handles quoted commas and multiline values; line = one-based logical record (header=1); fields stripped; wrong field count or empty sku/name -> invalid_row; price must be finite Decimal >=0 with <=2 fractional digits else invalid_price (no exceptions), formatted to exactly two decimals; first accepted SKU wins, later accepted duplicates -> duplicate_sku, invalid rows do not reserve SKU; order preserved. Interpretations not fixed by source: entirely blank logical rows are skipped (still counted), -0 normalizes to 0.00, exponent forms like 1e2 accepted as 100.00, trailing-zero precision like 1.100 rejected, csv.Error reported as invalid_row. Only upper.py changed.
